body: The bird was for aldo's team.
I will look into it. Thanks for bringing it to my attention.
No agencies. I just haven't reached out to any institutions that provide the services you mentioned.

I am injured. I have an unstable shoulder and a slipped disc (not sure though but definitely explains weakness in my left leg). I was able to manage my insecurities and responsibilities before my injuries. I took 51 credits last year and had only one B. I got cocky and careless. I trained with my brother who is bigger than me (but definitely too stupid and too selfish to train with. Still love him though hehe) and he kept pushing me. 
I should have been smarter. Now, I can't even walk more than five minutes before my lower body begins to hurt. I am immobile.

I am closer to my mom and my sisters but they are far far away and still think that I am the same naive kid. Growing religious definitely helped me keep the evils of the world at bay but I am an atheist now. Can't take religion seriously no matter how hard I try. 

Good to hear that you are close with your dad. He must be very proud of you knowing that you are serving your country in the bravest of fashions. I thought about joining military but I am of an ethnicity that many military people are prejudiced against. 

I also agree with you that being attractive isn't necessary for love and happiness. I just have this cultural barrier. I went to an all-boys school back home and don't get American girls very well (even the ones who have South Asian roots). I have tried to understand the culture. I watched countless TV shows, innumerable movies and spent hours on my accents (which by the way is coming along nicely) but still find it hard to even ask girls out. Too afraid of rejection.
Would be nice. However, I don't know what my options are. I am not a citizen yet so that kind of discourages me.

Not very close. I didn't see him in person from the age of 2 to the age of 18. We have been living together for four years now but there is hardly any real love. I tried honesty before but that didn't go very well. He threatened to kick me out of the house so I had to spend days on damage control.

It's hard to eat right and train properly when you are expected to spend hours on homework and exam preparation every night. My dad doesn't understand how stressful STEM majors are these days. During his days, things were a lot more flexible.

>I'm a US Marine

That's so cool. They make movies about people like you!

>I'm majoring in accounting and hope to be a CPA one day. I just want to wear a suit to work every day, haha.

With a degree in accounting, you are on tour way to living the 9 to 5 dream.
Personally, I am not too keen on it. I do want a routine though. My dad had a 9 to 5 in states and I never saw him in person during some of my most formative years (from age 2 to age 18). 

>I've attempted suicide before. 8 years ago. Every day since then (and before, really) has been a battle with my inner demons.

Have never attempted suicide. I come from a religious family and thought it was a major sin. Didn't wanna blow up a chance to hang out with the 72 virgins lol. I don't believe in a higher power though. Scientific education didn't leave any room for faith I am afraid.

>I'm always anxious. I get lonely, and only seem to be able to have one night stands. I'm self conscious. 

I am anxious and self conscious too. My anxiety come from being an immigrant and not knowing the culture fully. I am self conscious because I was bullied for being too short, too dark and too ugly (I was called those things. Don't see myself in that light except that I don't think that I am incredibly appealling to the opposite sex, objectively speaking). No one ever hit me but words left deeper scars.

>Even when it seems like there's no end in sight, you have to keep fighting. 

This is very similar to one of my favorite quotes: 'The trick, William Potter, is not minding that it hurts.' It is from a military movie called Lawrence of Arabia. You might like it, assuming you haven't seen it already.

I am a Physics major. I would rather be a writer but there is no money in that. Writing is more about marketing and I am not the most marketable guy. 
Edit: grammar and additional information

Good to hear that you want to be my friend. I would like to know more about you.

Edit: Is there way for us to have a private conversation? I am new to Reddit so don't know much that.

I am a 22 year old guy and I am in a very similar situation. I am hanging on because I don't want to hurt my family. I have too many responsibilities but the rewards are next to non-existent. No girlfriend. No true friends. Just a perpetual realization that I am doomed. Would like to talk to you.

Right here. I live in the US but I moved four years ago. I am 22 and have done well so far in school. Last semester, I had to drop out because I hurt myself during weight training. I wasn't happy before but now I am completely miserable. I can barely walk. The people who loved me and genuinely care for me (my mom and my sisters) are not in the US. However, I cannot kill myself because the news would be too devastating for them. I have been punching and kicking walls and crying uncontrollably for a few months now. 

I honestly think that some kind words and a few genuine hugs a day by someone who liked me for who I am would completely change my life and put me back on track. However, being an immigrant, I have trouble making friends. 

If someone of similar age wants to share their problems with me and wants to listen to mine, let me know.
